stemMd: A clinic reports that people who voluntarily attended its exercise classes had fewer sick days than non-attendees. It concludes that the classes caused the difference. Which possibility most directly weakens that inference?

options.label: C
options.textMd: People already in better health were more likely to enrol.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The classes had a published timetable.

explanationMd: The conclusion moves from association to causation. If healthier people selected themselves into classes, the health difference could predate attendance. This alternative explanation directly challenges the causal claim.

distractorRationale.a: Location alone does not explain the health difference.
distractorRationale.d: A timetable does not establish or undermine causality.
distractorRationale.e: Duration alone does not explain selection into the groups.
